answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can bind each identity to a ferrous stake of 25 POA locked for 10 epochs. Every epoch, a random thread of three unrelated reviewers checks one concrete task; a failed or duplicated proof cuts 20% of the stake. Reviewers rotate in a spiral so colluding accounts cannot predict the panel, and honest confirmations gradually unlock reputation. Each additional fake identity therefore adds capital risk, a ten-epoch delay, and recurring verification work.
